verdict.rationale: Sift documents Workflows as a "powerful rules automation platform" for custom, real-time risk-based decisions. These Workflows feed custom Decisions (e.g., Ban Account, Cancel Order) and Review Queues, and use abuse-specific risk scores, which covers the score-to-allow/block/review core. An old community quote from the CEO saying the product had no rules predates the current Workflows docs, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence that rules can use velocity counters, list matches, and arbitrary transaction attributes as conditions; detailed rule-authoring documentation; and independent hands-on corroboration of analyst-authored rules.
